items.title: 67619_Big Nick Nicholas oral history interview
items.q: the things I did with Buck Clayton, Frankie Lane on Columbia

ctx.x: They always want you to be on time, then you get there and you never knew what was going to happen. You wrote the music and you wonder, you know, if you would be able to play the music and then if you had a solo, naturally you were concerned about your solo. Well, the Manteca solo I enjoyed very much doing and then the things I did with Buck Clayton, Frankie Lane on Columbia. I liked those solos. And some solos I did with J.C. Heard on RCA Victor with Etta Jones, I liked some of those things and then those things…
I remember when you were doing the radio interview with Phil Schaap on (W)KCR, you had some phone calls...some people called in... I remember Al Hibbler...
